description.value: Once per round, while the knight has a shield equipped, when subjected to a damaging effect with a saving throw, the knight can use this ability by expending an attack of opportunity; he may then redirect half of the total damage he'd take from that effect (rounded down) to his shield. The shield's hardness is halved (rounded down) for this calculation. The knight may not use this ability with a broken shield. This ability cannot be combined with Evasion/Stalwart (or equivalent abilities) - the knight declares whether he benefits from them or this talent before making the saving throw.
